payload.description_html: Skeletal diagram of Hudiesaurus sinojapanorum. The vertebra is based on figures and measurements from Dong (1997), gotten from an [https://svpow.com/2009/05/05/hudiesaurus-redux/ SV-POW post). The silhouette is based on a Mamenchisaurus skeletal by Bricksmashtv. Human silhouette from File:Silhouette of man standing and facing forward.svg. The exact positioning of the vertebra is unknown, and could profoundly influence the overall length of the animal, so it should be taken with a grain of salt. Here it is reconstructed with a length of 27m.
